Subject: Lacuna SIG: Live walkthrough scheduling + log sample & attestation ask

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Lacuna is excited to move forward with a SIG/CAIQ intake and a short live walkthrough so our security team can validate controls and request any sample evidence. Can we book a 45–60m technical walk on either Apr 15 or Apr 16 (PDT)? We prefer morning slots (10:00–11:30).

High-level asks from our intake:
- Live SIG/CAIQ review (we'll run through the CAIQ and a few control areas)
- Short tech deep-dive on logging, key management, network isolation, and multi-tenant separation
- Sample logs (auth & admin activity) — 14-day window preferred; CSV or Syslog format is fine
- SOC 2 attestation (pdf) and CAIQ export if available
- Confirmation we can record the session and share notes with Lacuna's procurement team

If you can attach the CAIQ (or a link) and a short manifest of the types of logs you can provide ahead of the call, that would help us triage questions. Our security lead will be Ben Wu (me) and procurement will loop in once we have the artifact plan.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/lacuna/security-walkthrough-60

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Ben
